vibe: Linear/Superhuman meets Modern Healthcare. Operationally practical, fast, zero-clutter, highly legible.

layout.spacing_scale: Tailwind standard (p-4, p-6, gap-4, gap-6). Generous internal padding for forms, tight grid for dashboards.
layout.border_radius: rounded-sm (2px to 4px max) for a sharp, technical SaaS feel.
layout.sidebar: Fixed left sidebar, 260px width, extremely clean with subtle hover states (bg-secondary). No heavy background colors.
layout.surfaces: Cardless or Flat Solid. 1px solid border (border-border), NO shadows. Information hierarchy is driven by typography and spacing, not floating cards.

components.buttons: Flat, rounded-sm, 1px border for secondary buttons. Hover states explicitly change text color and background.
components.inputs: Flat, 1px border, rounded-sm, bg-white. Focus state: ring-2 ring-primary/20 border-primary.
components.tables: Dense, full width, 1px bottom border per row. Hover state on rows. text-sm for data density.
components.badges: rounded-full, very subtle background (e.g., bg-green-50 text-green-700), used for Lead Status.
components.modals: Glassmorphism overlay (backdrop-blur-sm bg-black/20), Modal body is solid white, flat borders, rounded-sm.

icons.style: Regular or Duotone for active states. Keep sizing consistent (w-5 h-5 for inline, w-4 h-4 for dense tables).

images.description: Cure & Care Hospital minimal cross and leaf logo

testing.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor icons via @phosphor-icons/react. Add to package.json if missing.
Do NOT use pure #000000. Text must be the primary dark forest green (#022C22) or dark gray.
Do not use box-shadows on standard cards/widgets. Rely on 1px borders and spacing.
Maintain high density in the dashboard views, similar to Linear or Superhuman. Use small fonts (text-sm) for data grids.
Ensure the WhatsApp inbox view looks familiar (green accents, chat bubbles) but aligns with the clean SaaS vibe.
